It was discovered from the orders you transported from the Academy and the Freighters you escorted that a fleet of Freighters are planning to dump toxic material on ConEx. They will be traveling through the Zebetrious system. Go to the Zebetrious system, destroy the Freighters, and return to <RST> by <DL>. You may have to Warp in and out before you kill all the the Light FreightersGood luck.
